---
title: "Session 7 · Joins, reshaping, and cleaning"
subtitle: "Use tidyverse tools to prepare related study tables"
---

## Learning goals

Build on Session 6's dplyr verbs to join tables by keys, check unmatched records,
and reshape measurements with tidyr. Clean text with stringr, manage factor
labels and order with forcats, and parse dates with lubridate.

## Materials

- [Slides](slides.qmd)
- [Guided lab](lab.qmd)
- Starter, choose one: [R Markdown](starter/reshape-joins-lab.Rmd) or
  [Quarto](starter/reshape-joins-lab.qmd)

Tasks 1–8 match the main lecture. Additional practice is optional.
Optional examples follow the related introduction: join details after basic
joins, pivot_longer details after wide-to-long, and pivot_wider details after
long-to-wide. Optional visit calculations follow the reshaping examples.
Each block has a skip link to the next main topic. These details are not
prerequisites for the core lab.

Session 16 retains the fuller treatment of strings and regular expressions.
